census.this_wave_reason: shipproof embeds the proofindex version in its versions member; the 1.2.0 bump legitimately regenerates it IN this wave — exactly the discipline the gate now enforces

doctrine: Determinism proves run-to-run sameness; freshness proves the committed evidence IS the current machinery's output.
A stale payload is not drift — its own stamp still verifies. Only a freshness gate sees that the machinery has moved.
A payload with no deterministic exporter is stated amber, never silently treated as fresh.
The runner is injected like a clock: the library stays stdlib-only and testable; the meta gate supplies the subprocess.

drills.drill: control — committed bytes equal a fresh export
dependency bump — machinery moved, evidence did not
exporter down — the failure is a verdict, not a crash
no deterministic exporter — manual discipline stated
committed file missing — absence stated, never faked

gate.seam: freshness_report(fresh, root=..., payloads=...) — the runner is INJECTED; proofindex never spawns a subprocess
